'''Alatar''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Wizard Tower (rift)}} in the [[Rift Dimension]].

__TOC__

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | First Interaction
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Alatar&f: &eTime&f flows differently in this &ddimension&f.
&e[NPC] Alatar&f: A lot of wizards, including me, try and study &eTime&f around here.
&e[NPC] Alatar&f: &bTomorrow&f you might come back here &ayesterday&f.
&e[NPC] Alatar&f: Maybe we already &ahad&f this conversation in the &bfuture&f.
&e[NPC] Alatar&f: Is there even a &abefore&f and an &bafter&f in this place?
&e[NPC] Alatar&f: Some speculate that we are in the past, some say in the &bfuture&f, perhaps we're always in the &epresent&f.
}}
|-
!Condition
!Random Dialogue
|-
| rowspan="2" class="ct" | None
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Alatar&f: A full revolution of events around here is what we here call a "business day".}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Alatar&f: All you have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to you.}}
|}

== Lore ==
{{NPCSprite|Dr. Emmett}} had '''Alatar''' summon an exact copy of a letter that [[The Watcher|Lathrop]] had failed to deliver. This and {{NPCSprite|Udium}}'s dialogue imply that Alatar doesn't originate in Rift Dimension, although it is unknown how he got in.

== Trivia ==
*'''Alatar''' is one of a few NPCs who are not originally from [[Rift Dimension]], alongside {{NPCSprite|Julian}}, {{NPCSprite|Barry}}, {{NPCSprite|Dr. Emmett}} and {{NPCSprite|Tel Kar}}.

'''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth I''' is an [[NPC]] on {{Zone|The Mountaintop}} in the [[Rift Dimension]]. They give the player a {{Skill|Mining}}-related quest outside the Rift in exchange for {{Item|Eleanor's Slippers}}.

== Purpose ==
'''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth I''' gives the player a {{Skill|Mining}} quest that they must complete outside the Rift.

Behind the nearby mirror, a replica of the player is equipped with {{Item|Heat Armor}} and a {{Lv|1}} {{Item|Silverfish Pet|rarity=leg}} while mining {{Item|Cobblestone}} with a [[Drill]] in the {{Zone|Slimehill}}.

To complete the quest, all of the following conditions must be met at the same time:
*Wear a full set of {{Item|Heat Armor}}, {{Item|Flamebreaker Armor}}, {{Item|Sorrow Armor}}, or {{Item|Armor of Divan}}.
*Equip an {{Item|Armadillo Pet}}, {{Item|Mithril Golem Pet}}, {{Item|Scatha Pet}}, {{Item|Silverfish Pet}}, or {{Item|Snail Pet}} of {{Legendary}} rarity or higher.
*Hold a [[Drill]] of any type.
*Be between {{Coords|32|64|27}} and {{Coords|52|75|3}} in the {{Zone|Slimehill}}.
*Sneak twice within one second.

Once completed, the message "''{{Mctxt|f|You sense a watchful presence...}}''" will appear in chat. The player can then return to '''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth I''' to claim {{Item|Eleanor's Slippers}}.

'''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth IX''' is an [[NPC]] on {{Zone|The Mountaintop}} in the [[Rift Dimension]] who gives the player a {{Skill|Fishing}}-related quest outside the Rift in exchange for {{Item|Eleanor's Tunic}}.

== Purpose ==
'''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth IX''' gives the player a [[Fishing]] quest that must be completed outside the Rift.

Behind the nearby mirror, a replica of the player is shown fishing in the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} while equipped with {{Item|Sponge Armor}} and a {{Lv|1}} {{Item|Flying Fish Pet|rarity=leg}}.

To complete the quest, all of the following conditions must be met at the same time:
*Wearing one of the following full Armor Sets:
** {{Item|Sponge Armor}}, {{item|Shark Scale Armor}}, {{Item|Nutcracker Armor}}
** {{Item|Gold Hunter Armor}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}}, {{Item|Diamond Hunter Armor}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}}, 
** {{Item|Diver's Armor}}, {{item|Abyssal Armor}};
** {{Item|Thunder Armor}}with {{item|Thunderbolt Necklace}}; 
** {{item|Magma Lord Armor}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}}, with {{item|Magma Lord Necklace}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}}.
*Equipping a [[Flying Fish Pet]] or [[Ammonite Pet]] of {{Legendary}} rarity or higher.
*Holding any [[Fishing Rod]].
*Being inside the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}} while within the coordinates {{coords|-130|195|-94}} and {{coords|-172|214|-49}}.
**The location is in a cave that can be accessed at {{coords|-121|205|-60}}.
*Splashing themselves with any potion.

Once completed, the message "''{{Mctxt|f|You sense a watchful presence...}}''" will appear in chat. The player can then return to '''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth IX''' to claim {{Item|Eleanor's Tunic}}.

'''Undercover Agent''' is an [[NPC]] that appears outside either the {{zone|Cathedral}} or {{zone|The Bastion}}, depending on the player's [[Faction]], after starting a Rescue Mission. 

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable ct"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|- class="article-row-main"
|First Interaction
|style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: Pst, hey [player]! You must be the one they sent to get our guy back.
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: Here's what you need to do.
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: You need to sneak through this area and avoid the guards.
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: You need to stay out of their &esight&f.
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: They also have remarkable &ehearing&f. &eSneaking &fwill be much harder for them to detect than &esprinting&f.
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: If you're observant, you might be able to &edistract &fsome of them.
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: If it's too dangerous for you, tell me. If you leave the area, we'll assume you've abandoned the mission and find someone else instead.
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: Good luck out there!
}}
|- class="article-row-main"
|Canceling Mission
|style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: It's too dangerous for you?
&e[NPC] Undercover Agent&f: Oh well, we'll find someone else. Leave before you're captured too.
}}
|}
